# Everglade: agent reference

> What an agent needs to work on this realm at this build: its wire and pins, content tables, shapes, limits, the driver's operations and the diagnostic codes. Generated by `coax/web/agent-reference.coax` from the sources named below; never edited by hand. It describes the build it is served beside, not `main`.

The site's index is [llms.txt](https://openagents.com/llms.txt). Look a Coax name up with `coax vocab NAME`.

## Build

- realm: everglade
- page: `/worlds/everglade2` (module `everglade2`, source `apps/openagents-web/realms/everglade2/`)
- wire: 7 (`everglade/shared/everglade-wire.coax` `WIRE_VERSION`). A room also seats a page one version behind, 6, for one release. A frame written for any other version is refused with `r 0 version`
- pins: engine 1, rules 1, content 1 (`WIRE_ENGINE`, `WIRE_RULES`, `WIRE_CONTENT`). A page says them before its hello. A room refuses a hello whose pins are neither its own nor the release before's (`r 0 version`)
- content: `everglade/content/everglade.content`, revision 2, sha256 `7f7cace1e119d532810b06c947873926563c97f8d2c072c058780c30f6f692ac`; on the wire its pin is 2
- diagnostics: `engine-diagnostics-v1`, 17 codes, sha256 `55aa5a9b50ff02e1256e64909abf901a29f9c98a1575ae6b669281410b69c31c` (`proto/verse/engine-diagnostics-v1.json`)
- language: Coax; the compiler's version is in `coax/release-status.json` and what it claims to do in `coax/book/capability-claims.json`
- reference: the last line of this file is the sha256 of everything above it. Two builds with the same line have the same reference

## State and authority

From `metaverse-engine/editor/authority.coax` (INVARIANTS.md, "Authoring never writes durable state").

- content, who may change what is authored: admins
- simulation, what decides what is running: room
- durability, what holds what outlives a session: ledger

| Operation | May write |
| --- | --- |
| edit | authored, running |
| undo | authored, running |
| redo | authored, running |
| content-rollback | authored, running |
| world-save | authored |
| world-load | authored, running |
| publish | authored |
| code-reload | running |
| sim-step | running |
| ledger | durable |
| character | durable |

## Content tables

- format: `aethyr.content.v1` (docs/protocol/aethyr-content-v1.md): one text document; a `table NAME COLUMNS` line, then a row a line, cells split by `|`
- document: everglade
- revision: 2
- reach, cm: 100000

| Table | Columns | Rows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ability` | `id name:text` | 83 |
| `creature` | `id name:text kind:int xp:int` | 5 |
| `dialogue` | `id npc:text point:ref.point quest:opt.quest line:text` | 6 |
| `item` | `id name:text slot:int` | 4 |
| `loot` | `id creature:ref.creature item:opt.item weight:int` | 6 |
| `point` | `id name:text x:cm z:cm r:int` | 18 |
| `quest` | `id name:text` | 5 |
| `reward` | `id quest:ref.quest item:opt.item coin:int xp:int` | 5 |
| `spawn` | `id creature:ref.creature point:ref.point count:int` | 12 |
| `step` | `id quest:ref.quest creature:opt.creature point:opt.point item:opt.item talk:opt.dialogue count:int` | 14 |
| `template` | `id creature:ref.creature block:int style:int notice:int leash:int run:int` | 5 |
| `troop` | `id spawn:ref.spawn group:int face:int respawn:int slot:int` | 12 |

A table's first column is `id`. Another column is `NAME:int`, `NAME:text`, `NAME:cm` (centimetres), `NAME:ref.TABLE` (the id of a row of TABLE) or `NAME:opt.TABLE` (the same, or 0 for none). A row's id is never changed or used again.

## Wire and stored shapes

The rows of `proto/registry.json` whose codec or files are this realm's (under `everglade/`, `coax/web/room/`, `metaverse-engine/content/`, `metaverse-engine/session/`, `metaverse-engine/net/`, `metaverse-engine/agent/`). Each has one codec file; read a shape through it and never write its bytes by hand (proto/README.md).

## Limits

Every limit is shown here and none is hidden. Past one, the engine refuses or drops the work and says so: ask `why caps`.

| Limit | Value | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| players in one room | 16 | `WIRE_SEATS` in `everglade/shared/everglade-wire.coax` |
| bytes in a frame a page sends | 1024 | `WIRE_FRAME` in `everglade/shared/everglade-wire.coax` |
| bytes in a frame a room sends | 3800 | `WIRE_SERVER_FRAME` in `everglade/shared/everglade-wire.coax` |
| ms the item ledger remembers an operation id | 86400000 | `LEDGER_KEEP` in `metaverse-engine/session/ledger.coax` |
| bytes in a content document | 65536 | `CT_BODY` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| tables in a content document | 16 | `CT_TABLES` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| columns in a table, its id among them | 8 | `CT_COLS` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| rows in a content document | 1024 | `CT_ROWS` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| bytes in a document's, a table's or a column's name | 15 | `CT_NAME` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| entities the driver's tree lists in a frame | 128 | `DRV_ENTS` in `metaverse-engine/agent/drive.coax` |
| HUD widgets the layout trace keeps in a frame | 768 | `UIT_MAX` in `metaverse-engine/ui/trace.coax` |

## Operations

`coax/web/tool.sh drive web apps/openagents-web /worlds/everglade2 OP...` drives the page in headless Chrome, one operation an argument (coax/start-here.md).

| Operation | What it answers |
| --- | --- |
| `tree`, `layout` | What is in the world and on the HUD, by stable id |
| `state PATH` | A field of the realm's state |
| `why ID`, `why caps` | Why a thing isn't seen, reached or working; the limits applied this run |
| `hit X Y`, `taps` | What receives a tap at a point; tap targets that are small, covered or overlapping |
| `tap ID`, `type ID TEXT` | A click on a widget; typing into it |
| `walk-to ID`, `face ID`, `use ABILITY on ID`, `mount ID`, `stop` | A world operation, as a player's input; the room decides the outcome |
| `clock +MS`, `clock settle`, `clock until PATH` | Steps the agent clock |
| `screenshot FILE`, `logs`, `perf` | The page as it is, its console, its frame counters |

## Diagnostic codes

`why ID` answers with the first failed link of state, spawned, view, drawn, asset, collider, system (docs/metaverse/diagnostics.md).

| Number | Code | Id | Link | Retry |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `not-in-state` | `engine.diagnostic.not-in-state.v1` | state | no |
| 2 | `spawn-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.spawn-pending.v1` | spawned | yes |
| 3 | `spawn-refused` | `engine.diagnostic.spawn-refused.v1` | spawned | no |
| 4 | `despawned` | `engine.diagnostic.despawned.v1` | spawned | no |
| 5 | `not-in-view` | `engine.diagnostic.not-in-view.v1` | view | no |
| 6 | `draw-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-pending.v1` | drawn | yes |
| 7 | `draw-dropped` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-dropped.v1` | drawn | no |
| 8 | `draw-hidden` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-hidden.v1` | drawn | no |
| 9 | `asset-loading` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-loading.v1` | asset | yes |
| 10 | `asset-failed` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-failed.v1` | asset | no |
| 11 | `asset-missing` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-missing.v1` | asset | no |
| 12 | `collider-missing` | `engine.diagnostic.collider-missing.v1` | collider | no |
| 13 | `collider-open` | `engine.diagnostic.collider-open.v1` | collider | no |
| 14 | `system-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.system-pending.v1` | system | yes |
| 15 | `system-paused` | `engine.diagnostic.system-paused.v1` | system | no |
| 16 | `budget-hit` | `engine.diagnostic.budget-hit.v1` | runtime | no |
| 17 | `pack-refused` | `engine.diagnostic.pack-refused.v1` | runtime | no |

## Examples

Ask what is there, then why one thing isn't:

```sh
coax/web/tool.sh drive web apps/openagents-web /worlds/everglade2 "tree" "why you" "why caps" "taps"
```

An answer:

```text
why you: not-in-view
code: engine.diagnostic.not-in-view.v1
link: view (3 of 7)
field: camera.frame
expected: inside the frame
actual: past its right edge
retry: no
passed: state spawned
```

A content row, under its table's line:

```text
table ability id name:text
128|Rage
```

reference sha256: 128cad6851422fa1a7555f36c33f182cf26d19892d28c0e4e7182228acf2ab3b
